full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the 46th Batch of Guiding Cases

Fa [2025] No. 77

The Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Upon deliberation and decision by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, the five cases (Guiding Cases No. 257-261), including the case of X Environmental Research Institute of Changping District, Beijing v. X Watershed Hydropower Development Co., Ltd. — civil public interest litigation for ecological damage, are hereby released as the 46th batch of guiding cases for reference in adjudicating similar cases.

May 26, 2025
